It’s been six months since the ChatVoteCombo stream began. For six straight months, I’ve voted almost every single day without missing a beat. I've seen players who started this journey with me and later quit, some who came back after disappearing, and others who were completely new. I’ve witnessed a lot throughout this time.

What ChatVoteCombo demanded from us above all else was consistency and that alone was incredibly difficult for most people. On top of that, I saw players lose everything they worked for because of a single small mistake. That’s when I truly understood the real nature of this game. ChatVoteCombo took a lot from us. The most crucial rule of this stream was simple: if you wanted to protect your combo, you had to vote every 24 hours. No exceptions. Unlike other streams, this one demanded perfection something no human being can truly achieve. We all make mistakes, whether we mean to or not.

When I first began, I had no specific goal. All I wanted was to embark on a journey. As time passed, I made significant progress. Then my purpose shifted: I wanted to show others what we could achieve if we just kept going, if we never gave up. That became my motivation.

Throughout all this time, I’ve lost over 300,000 combo and hundreds of millions of points. And many of those losses weren’t even my fault. I, along with many others, experienced unfairness. But even after everything, this game taught me something important: everything passes. Nothing is forever. We shouldn’t dwell on the past no matter what happens, we must keep moving forward.

Because in the end, what truly matters in this journey...

More Than Just Numbers

For me, this stream… it was never just votes or combos, you know? At first, I thought, okay, just numbers, just clicks… nothing big. But somehow, it became more. I don’t really know when it changed, but it felt different, deeper. Hard to explain.

I started here without thinking much. Didn’t think it would matter, or take so much from me. But day by day, vote by vote… I realized, it’s not only about points. What we get is… feelings, memories, little struggles. They stay with you. Even when points disappear, they stay.

People came and went. Some left forever, some came back after long time, and new ones kept coming. Every person, somehow, changed the journey a bit. Laughter, friendship… yes. But also frustration, unfair losses. I lost hundreds of thousands of combo… millions of points sometimes… and not always my fault. But… I kept going anyway.

What surprised me most? Not the wins, not the numbers… but people. Strangers, from different countries, different languages… and still, we somehow understood each other. Strange… and kind of beautiful. I realized feelings are same everywhere — hope, sadness, joy, desire to continue.

There were times I felt broken, really… I asked myself, why I’m still here? And every time… answer came back: this is more than game. It’s a story. A path. And as long as I walk it, I’m not alone.

Even if one day it ends… I know the time spent is not wasted. It stays with me. Memories, lessons… proof that meaning can be found even in smallest, unexpected places.

For me, ChatVoteCombo never about perfection. That never existed. It’s about moving forward anyway. Finding strength after every loss. Realizing that it’s not the goal… it’s the road. And the people beside you.

Never just numbers on screen.
It was a journey — full of struggle, full of feelings, full of meaning.
